text:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Aggregate cost across repeated passes**

When variance evidence repeats each configuration on the same head set, every head has multiple model-call and elapsed-time observations, but this metric specifies only averaging across heads. The remaining repeated-run path is fresh evidence not resolved by the earlier cost-aggregation fix: selecting the first repetition, averaging within each head, or averaging all head/run pairs can produce different reported effects. Define how repetitions are paired and reduced before computing the per-head mean.
